Guide.Title: Making frame images
Guide.Intro: Each frame set has two cap images: one along the top edge of a card and one along the bottom. The same images are used on the small cards and the large card. The two ends of each image keep their shape; only the middle stretches to fit the card's width.
Guide.Stretch: middle stretches: keep it the same left to right
Guide.Canvas: Canvas: {width} × {height} px (8 : 1). Draw the corners and ornaments in the outer {slice} px at each end.
Guide.Format: Format: SVG is best: sharp at every size and small. Otherwise use PNG or WebP with a transparent background. Avoid JPG: it has no transparency.
Guide.Middle: Middle: only flat bands and straight lines, identical at every point left to right. Emblems placed in the middle get stretched.
Guide.Top: Top cap: keep the plate near the top edge. The card's value text sits over the top cap, so leave the lower part mostly transparent.
Guide.Bottom: Bottom cap: the mirror of the top cap. The d20 button sits in the centre of the bottom cap, so keep the centre low-contrast.
Guide.Sizes: Shown at: small card 14 px (top) and 18 px (bottom) tall; large card 22 px each. Drawing at about 4× that height keeps detail on high-resolution screens.
Guide.Weight: File size: keep each image under about 100 KB. One file is reused for every card.
Guide.Storage: Where to keep them: upload to your world's folder (for example worlds/your-world/frames/) so module updates never overwrite them.
Guide.Custom: Other layouts: if your ends are not 96 px, or your image is not 64 px tall, enter your own End width and Image height, measured in the image's pixels.

standard.label: Standard frames
standard.hint: Warframe-style rarity: steel, damaged, bronze, silver and gold. Used by every character unless their sheet has High-contrast frames turned on.

contrast.label: High-contrast frames
contrast.hint: Colour-blind-friendly: red, orange, green and sky blue, chosen to stay distinct for protan, deutan and tritan colour vision. Each character's sheet can switch to these in Settings → Sheet layout.
